name: scene3d89
version: 1.1.0
phase: phase2:scene_orchestration_manager
language: C89 / gnu89
memory: fixed arrays, no malloc/free/realloc/heap
math: fixed-point 16.16, no float/double
features:
  - pure scene manager
  - scene tree
  - scene graph
  - scene load/unload requests
  - scene slots: persistent, level, room, overlay, world_cell
  - scene dependency refs
  - prefab/scene-template instancing
  - portal-sector visibility hints
  - dirty subtree traversal
  - DAG semantic overlay
  - optional text manifest reader
